senses.zh_definition: Galavan：外来姓氏，例如电视剧《哥谭》中 Theo Galavan 与 Tabitha Galavan 的姓；未核实到小写 galavan 的马来语普通词义。
senses.en_definition: Galavan: a surname, borne for example by Theo and Tabitha Galavan in Gotham; no common Malay lexical meaning has been verified.
senses.ms_definition: Galavan ialah nama keluarga, misalnya bagi watak Theo Galavan dan Tabitha Galavan dalam siri Gotham; makna sebagai kata umum bahasa Melayu belum dapat disahkan.
senses.nuances: 此处为专名说明，非 DBP 官方释义。DC 官方资料确认这两个人物使用 Galavan 姓氏。[DC 官方人物介绍](https://www.dc.com/blog/2015/09/21/five-things-to-look-for-when-gotham-returns-and-one-thing-to-not)。下列搭配为教学示例，未验证其使用频率。

etymology.historical_story: Galavan is documented as a surname, including in DC’s account of Theo and Tabitha Galavan in Gotham. Its appearance in translated dialogue does not establish a Malay common-word meaning. The supplied packet provides no etymological evidence, so neither a Malay origin nor an original surname meaning can responsibly be assigned. [DC character introduction](https://www.dc.com/blog/2015/09/21/five-things-to-look-for-when-gotham-returns-and-one-thing-to-not).
